title: Exterior tensor quotient is epimorphic
statement: Let A, B, C be sheaves of modules on a scheme X, and let g:B→C be an epimorphism. Using exterior sheaves and wedge sections [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], for any natural numbers r,s there exists an epimorphism q:(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s B)→(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s C), taking (∧a_i)⊗(∧c_j) to (∧a_i)⊗(∧g(c_j)) on every open.

proof.text: Construct the official exterior-power presheaf morphism sectionwise from exteriorPower.map applied to g. Check naturality on pure wedges using PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti, map_apply_ιMulti, and naturality_apply. Sheafification and naturality of the adjunction unit compute the map on wedge sections. Tensor with the identity on exteriorPower A r and use tensorHom_app_tmulSection.

If two morphisms have equal composites with the constructed map, evaluating on tensors of wedges gives equality on the lifted wedge generators. Apply the official exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext to conclude equality, which is exactly the cancellation condition defining Epi.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorTensor_quotient_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (A B C : X.Modules)
    (g : B ⟶ C) [Epi g] (r s : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower B s ⟶
        exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower C s,
      Epi q ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
        (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)),
        q.val.app (op U)
            (tmulSection (wedge (M := A) (r := r) (U := U) a)
              (wedge (M := B) (r := s) (U := U) c)) =
          tmulSection (M := exteriorPower A r) (N := exteriorPower C s)
            (wedge (M := A) (r := r) (U := U) a)
            (wedge (M := C) (r := s) (U := U) (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i)))
lean.note: Retirement of the Sheaf twin; the official theorem uses exteriorPower and wedge, representing the same exterior sheaf construction.
